headline: Missouri State finishes unbeaten away as Charlotte falls
dek: A draw at Indiana left Missouri State with thirteen wins and only two defeats, while Charlotte fell at Wisconsin on the same afternoon. No matches remain on the schedule, and Missouri State finished with more victories than any other program.
displaced_by: Sunday's results closed the schedule as Missouri State drew at Indiana and Charlotte lost at Wisconsin.
